features: Moves R2 / TradingView Scan / save / count / last-update chips into the header beside the title.
Replaces the full-width add button with a fixed right-edge + button that remains visible while scrolling.
Splits the monitor into CRYPTO and RWA / US-stock-token panes while preserving the same sortable indicator columns.
RWA classification loads from the existing /api/symbols/us-stock R2-backed endpoint; a small fallback set is used only if that endpoint is unavailable.
Both panes share the same sort/search state and keep independent row numbering.
TradingView Scanner 10-second live OHLC and v0.3.08 first-load-current-price behavior remain unchanged.
